phase-summary.outcome: Completed the first explicit product-entry slice for the KAPLAY demo. Planning docs now describe the repo as a schema-first content delivery engine with KAPLAY as the first consumer, and the runtime now starts from a real menu with New Game / Continue plus an opening beat before room navigation.

changes.item: Added `.planning/PROJECT-SUMMARY.xml` and synced Phase 46 planning artifacts around the content-delivery-engine framing.
Refactored `packages/kaplay-demo/src/main.ts` to replace auto-boot behavior with a real menu, Continue detection, and a fresh-run intro path.
Added fresh-run reset helpers for local UI/discovery state so New Game does not inherit prior-room presentation data.
Adjusted initial presenter feed text so a new run reads like narrative setup instead of a debug/control instruction.
Queued `46-04` as the next room-loop cleanup slice.

open-issues.item: `pnpm dlx ultracite check` still reports existing style debt in `packages/kaplay-demo/src/grid.ts`; this slice did not attempt a repo-wide style cleanup.
